response.original_title: 【{Official™-Information}】How Can I Request an Extra Passenger on My MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a Passenger to a MSC Line cruise, contact1-877-698-2211 their reservations team directly rather than using an automated online tool. You can reach them by calling 1-877-698-2211or 1-877-698-2211, or by using Live Chat on the MSC Line reservations page (if you booked through a travel advisor, contact them instead).You cannot add a passenger online through the website or app; you must contact1-877-698-2211 MSC Line directly 1-877-698-2211or reach out to your travel advisor. Because adding a Passenger affects cabin occupancy, lifeboat capacity, and fare rules, a specialist must process the update manually.
